subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & $/1M token targets
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & $/1M token targets

Hi Sofia / Liam — thanks again for taking the call this afternoon. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Call recap (5m):
- Use cases: chat customer support + semantic search/embeddings for knowledge base.
- Expected volume: you mentioned steady-state 2-3B tokens/month with short-term peaks up to ~5B.
- Current stack: mix of OpenAI for chat + Anthropic for safety checks.
- Key asks: target $/1M tokens you need to hit, budget range, and procurement timing.

Action items / asks for Acme:
1) Can you confirm: average monthly tokens, peak month tokens, and breakdown by feature (chat vs embeddings)?
2) What is your target $/1M tokens vs what you currently pay to OpenAI/Anthropic?
3) Any procurement constraints (PO timeline, security/contract must-haves)?

What I shared on our side:
- Preliminary target: Redwood hosted can be competitive vs OpenAI/Anthropic in $/1M tokens; we also have Dedicated (reserved capacity) that meaningfully reduces unit cost for large, committed volumes.
- Attached: pricing deck + baseline economics for hosted vs dedicated.

Next steps:
- Sofia/Liam: share token volume breakdown + current invoices (even a redacted CSV).
- Marissa/Aditya: I'll loop you in to build a tailored quote and run a unit-cost comparison.
- If numbers line up, schedule a 30-min pricing review with Acme procurement and finance next week.

Closing: happy to be pragmatic here — if your target $/1M is public, it helps us propose a structure (hosted tier discounts, committed Dedicated delta, or a hybrid).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: 20260220-redwood-pricing-deck.pdf

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & $/1M token targets

Thanks Vanessa — great call. See the numbers below and a redacted token export attached (acme-token-report.csv).

Quick answers:
- Average monthly tokens: ~2.2B (last 3 months avg).
- Peak month: ~5.1B (holiday peak scenario).
- Breakdown: ~70% chat (completion-heavy), ~30% embeddings/semantic search.
- Current unit economics: we benchmarked last quarter at roughly OpenAI ~ $30 / 1M tokens for chat-heavy traffic (mix of gpt-* completions + embeddings costs baked in), Anthropic at ~$28 / 1M for safety + moderation routing. Our current blended cost is ~ $29.50 / 1M.
- Target budget: ideally $20-25 / 1M to hit our cost model for new features. Procurement prefers not to exceed $25 / 1M without exec approval.
- Timeline: procurement can issue PO by end of March if pricing and security are green.

Constraints: SOC2 + IP/data retention terms are required; we have an internal security questionnaire to share.

Let us know if the attached CSV is enough — happy to pull another export if you need token-by-route detail.

Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Head of AI Products | Acme AI
sofia@acme.ai

Attachments: acme-token-report.csv

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & $/1M token targets

Appreciate the detail, Sofia — very helpful. Short reply with our initial thinking and internal asks.

Preliminary pricing posture (ballpark):
- Hosted API (no commit): list $/1M: $22 for chat-dominant workloads.
  - Volume tiers: 0-1B: $26 / 1M; 1-3B: $22 / 1M; 3B+: $18 / 1M (sliding discounts).
- Dedicated (12mo commit, reserved GPU pool): effective unit cost can get to ~$10-14 / 1M depending on model selection and quantization/packing.
- Hybrid: start hosted, commit to Dedicated after a 60-90 day pilot to achieve the lower committed unit economics.

Comparative notes vs OpenAI/Anthropic: based on your reported blended $29.5 / 1M target, Redwood hosted can be at or below current costs with modest volume — Dedicated is where the biggest delta shows up. We'll run a line-item cost model (tokens x model variant x run-time) to show break-even points.

Internal asks: Marissa / Aditya — can you: (1) run a quick cost model against the attached CSV to produce a $/1M blended comparison (Redwood hosted vs OpenAI vs Anthropic) and (2) draft 1-2 pricing options (hosted tier + 12mo Dedicated commit) that hit Acme's $20-25 / 1M target? I'm attaching a preliminary quote.

Next customer-facing step: schedule 30-min pricing review with Acme procurement + finance. Sofia — are you available Wed 02/25 or Thu 02/26 at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachments: 20260222-prelim-quote.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@acme.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & $/1M token targets

Looping in pricing ops / finance. Quick recommendations and proposed structure to hit Acme's target: 

1) Intro discount + tiering: Offer a 15% intro discount for months 1-3 on hosted rates (effectively bringing 1-3B tier from $22 -> ~$18.7 / 1M) to get them under $20-25 while we prove latency and quality.
2) Committed Dedicated path: For a 12-month commit (target utilization >=70%), we can structure an effective $/1M of $12-14 depending on model family and quantization. Require a 12mo minimum ARR commit and a short onboarding credit for the first month.
3) Procurement/legal: we'll need SOC2 attestations and the security questionnaire answered; Vanessa, can you provide the SOC2 report and redwood data retention policy?
4) Benchmark ask: Aditya — please run a token-level cost compare vs OpenAI and Anthropic using Acme's CSV (include per-route cost, per-1M token equivalent, and the projected blended rate for each scenario).

I'll draft two options in HubSpot and include a DocuSign-ready SOW (term sheet) once Aditya confirms the numbers. Vanessa — I left a quick HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (ACME-3456).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Pricing & GTM Economics | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
